verdict.rationale: Logseq is presented as a privacy-first, open-source knowledge base, and community users describe it as offline-first with local data and no mandatory subscription. Users sync it themselves through GitHub, and the vendor's Logseq Sync is an optional add-on, so the system runs without the vendor cloud. missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly describing local-only operation, an official self-hosted sync backend (users rely on DIY git sync), and self-hosted web/server mode (a community request notes it is unavailable).
